name: starcam
black_level_notes: OV5647 electronic zero, PER FRAME in 10-bit LSB-aligned ADU, measured from this camera's own 4x coadd floor: 61.184 / 4 = 15.30. Independently corroborated by eclipticam-v1 (10180/10/64 = 15.9). Added 2026-08-20; this camera has no `pedestal` (chart floor) because it has no live brightness chart — add one if that changes, and do NOT reuse this value for it.
blackest_observed_notes: Darkest recorded frame mean on the 4x-COADD basis (n=7116, 2026-05-24) — i.e. 4 frames summed, so ~15.30 per frame, which lands on black_level with essentially no footroom. The other starcam mode (ov5647_10bit_subs) floors at 0.001, meaning its black level was already subtracted upstream; those two modes are NOT on a common scale. Resolve before using starcam in any cross-camera accumulation.
plate_scale_notes: OV5647 stock lens, 53.50 deg horizontal / 2592 px (official RPi figure). Heavy barrel distortion, not yet characterised.
pole_prior_notes: 2x2-binned coords (1296x972 frame) — pipeline-night's --pole-x/--pole-y defaults. NOT full-res pixels.
night_layout_notes: night/YYYY-MM-DD/HH/<epoch_ms>.npy raw Bayer from the Pi 1B; to-fits converts in place to .fits.fz; HHb/ siblings hold 2x2 binned frames.
processing_host_notes: Pi 1B cannot process on-host; all pipeline stages run on puppy where the NFS frames land.
s3_legacy_notes: Dual-publish target during transition — the live /starcam/* website pages read this bucket.
